name: Alert banners
summary: Four inline notices (info, success, warning and danger), each with a bold first phrase, one sentence, an optional action and a dismiss button.
use: for telling people something about the page they are on, from a tip to a failure
a11y: Info, success and warning use role status and the danger notice uses role alert; actions and dismiss are real buttons, and dismissing moves focus to the next notice.

use_when: a stack of page-level notices of mixed urgency, each with its own fix and a way to dismiss it
avoid_when: a short confirmation after an action that should go away on its own: use toast-stack
a page with nothing to show yet: use empty-state
a question the person must answer before going on: use confirm-dialog

parts.name: notices
parts.what: one notice, toned info, success, warning or danger

parts.name: icon
parts.what: the tone's icon in a tinted circle

parts.name: message
parts.what: a bold first phrase, then one sentence

parts.name: actions
parts.what: zero to two buttons that fix or explain the notice; one may be the strong danger button

parts.name: dismiss
parts.what: an icon button that hides the notice

empty.how: when every notice is dismissed the list is left empty; remove the list, or show nothing in its place

loading.how: notices describe a state that is already known; do not show one until its message is ready

error.how: the danger notice is the error form, announced at once as an alert, with a strong fix button

disabled.how: while an action runs, set disabled on its button and add a :disabled style in the muted text colour

overflow.how: action buttons wrap to a new line, and in a narrow box each takes the full width

long_text.how: the message column can shrink and wraps; button labels never wrap

keyboard: Tab reaches each notice's action buttons, then its Dismiss button, notice by notice
Enter or Space presses the focused button
Dismissing a notice moves focus to the Dismiss button of the next notice, or the previous one if it was last
